# commit

Record staged changes to the repository.

## JavaScript

```ts
git.commit({ message: string, amend?: boolean, allowEmpty?: boolean, author?: string, verify?: boolean })
```

## CLI

```bash
git --no-pager commit --message <message> [--amend] [--allow-empty] [--author <author>] [--verify]
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `--message` | `string` | Yes | - | Commit message. |
| `amend` | `--amend` | `boolean` | No | - | Replace the previous commit. |
| `allowEmpty` | `--allow-empty` | `boolean` | No | - | Permit a commit with no staged changes. |
| `author` | `--author` | `string` | No | - | Override the commit author, as "Name <email>". |
| `verify` | `--verify` | `boolean` | No | `true` | Run pre-commit and commit-msg hooks. |

## Examples

**Commit staged changes**

```ts
await git.commit({
  message: 'Add wrapper template',
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager commit --message 'Add wrapper template'
```

**Commit without hooks**

```ts
await git.commit({
  message: 'wip',
  verify: false,
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager commit --message wip --no-verify
```
